digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 36
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Quillon Evals adds shared datasets
items.summary: Quillon Evals adds shared datasets that several projects can read. Datasets are versioned, and a run records which version it used.
items.whyItMatters: A run records which version of a dataset it used.

items.title: Redmarsh Runtime ends support for version 3
items.summary: Redmarsh Runtime 3 reaches end of support on 30 November. Security fixes continue until then.
items.whyItMatters: Projects on version 3 have a deadline.

items.title: Harrowgate Auth adds passkey login
items.summary: Harrowgate Auth adds passkey login for hosted sign-in pages. Existing password accounts can add a passkey from the profile page.
items.whyItMatters: Existing password accounts can add a passkey from the profile page.

sources.title: Quillon Evals adds shared datasets
sources.summary: Quillon Evals adds shared datasets that several projects can read. Datasets are versioned, and a run records which version it used. Access is controlled per dataset.

sources.title: Redmarsh Runtime ends support for version 3
sources.summary: Redmarsh Runtime 3 reaches end of support on 23 November. Security fixes continue until then. Version 4 is a drop-in upgrade for most projects.

sources.title: Harrowgate Auth adds passkey login
sources.summary: Harrowgate Auth adds passkey login for hosted sign-in pages. Existing password accounts can add a passkey from the profile page. Admins can require passkeys for chosen groups.
